name: history-search-overlay
notes: The one overlay with a legal non-slash opener, because ctrl+r IS in the token set. Its result count and rows come from the real prompt history, so this is the corpus's clearest ENV-dependent baseline: pin HOME and seed a fixture history file, or keep it out of the blocking tier. The overlay also forces prompt_focused false (render/mod.rs:107), which is a state worth a follow-up scenario of its own.
